function.description: Determines the amount of tax owed for a given income. It takes into account various deductions and tax credits. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tax_credits.description: The total amount of tax credits the individual is claiming in dollars. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "stwórz w css kartę która będzie się obracać po najechaniu kursorem". That's Polish: "create in CSS a card that will rotate on hover". So they want CSS code for a card that rotates when hovered. They didn't specify details like rotation angle or speed. We can provide an example with HTML and CSS. Provide a simple card with transform: rotateY(180deg) or rotateX? We'll give a card that flips horizontally (like a flip card). Provide container, front and back. Use perspective. Provide CSS transitions. Also mention that you need to set transform-style: preserve-3d. Provide example.

We don't need to call the function. Just produce CSS/HTML snippet.
